subject: Nanomedicine that targets ATP synthase reverses bone aging in mice
script: From Agewell Brief: Nanomedicine that targets ATP synthase reverses bone aging in mice. A new class of energy-metabolism-engaged nanomedicines (EM-eNMs) infiltrates mitochondria, triggers fission and mitophagy, and restores stemness in aged bone marrow cells, reversing osteoporotic bone loss in mice. EM-eNMs bind ATP synthase, inducing DRP1-mediated mitochondrial fission. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
